held_constant: Original states, warmstart, target/gain/velocity/feedforward sequences, torque limits, robot, contacts and solver. Only actuator implementation changes.
builtin_definition: gain0=kp; bias0=kd*vtarget+ff; bias1=-kp; bias2=-kd; ctrl=qtarget; ctrllimited=false; forcerange=+-canonical limits
zero_definition: Original motor actuator, ctrl=0 torque at every substep; no PD feedback
conclusion: Builtin affine position PD does not eliminate this captured instability: it delays BADQACC/reset by one 5ms substep. Zero motor torque remains finite from the earliest captured state. This local switch does not establish behavior of a fresh closed-loop run initialized with builtin PD.
